title: Quiz: Capstone Project
description: Check your understanding of Capstone Project.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in Swift?
questions.explanation: In Swift, // marks a comment. Block comments use /* */.

questions.question: What is the best first step for a capstone project?
options: Define the smallest version that works end-to-end
questions.correctAnswer: Define the smallest version that works end-to-end

questions.question: True or False: Adding features one at a time makes debugging much easier.
Fill in the blank: while game_running { play_round() }  // the main ___
questions.explanation: Games and tools center on a main loop.

questions.question: In Swift, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
